theory: Matching equal angles alone does not determine corresponding vertices of general similar polygons: repeated angles require corresponding side relationships and boundary order as well. Qualify the facts and first step accordingly; the booklet's polygon example uses both corresponding sides and angles.
summary: Replaced statement-only correspondence questions and unsupported error-analysis demands with cited figure-based booklet tasks, corrected the reflected-enlargement description, and retained all item locators and quiz ids. Qualified the theory and affected polygon working to use corresponding sides and boundary order when angles repeat; no whole items were removed.
reviewSummary: All fifteen requested items have correct answers and assess question types explicitly asked in the supplied booklet; each reviewed quiz has exactly one correct option and accurate distractor explanations. The theory correctly teaches corresponding vertex order, including the need to distinguish repeated angles using sides and boundary order, and no repairs or removals are required.
